grade_reason: Zero wins across 12 trades with 0% win rate; every position hit stop-loss immediately, indicating a fundamental strategy flaw rather than random variance.
failure_patterns: Stop-losses are positioned too tight relative to volatility, triggering exits on normal market noise rather than allowing meaningful moves to develop.
All trades are executed without any visible entry signal or confirmation mechanism, suggesting a blind entry approach that lacks directional bias.
Consistent losses across all three asset classes indicate a systematic error in the underlying trading logic rather than asset-specific issues.
position_sizing_rationale: With zero wins and maximum drawdown on every trade, reducing position size is necessary to prevent catastrophic capital erosion while retraining the strategy.
retrain_focus: Incorporate entry confirmation signals (e.g., volume spikes, candlestick patterns, moving average alignments) and expand stop-loss distance to at least 2x ATR to avoid noise-triggered exits.
data_curation_advice: Include only trades that show a confirmed entry signal with at least 2x ATR stop-loss distance. Exclude all blind entries, range-bound entries, and trades where stop-loss was within 1x ATR.
